cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: Can I get money back if I withdraw from BCIT courses or programs after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Whether you can get your money back after classes start depends on your specific program or course type, and whether you withdraw before the program's refund deadline. 

* **Full-Time Programs:** For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is **10 business days after the start of class**, though commitment fees are non-refundable (domestic commitment fees are typically $200–$1,000 depending on the program, and international commitment fees are $6,000). If you are withdrawn by BCIT for discipline or unsatisfactory progress after the deadline, you are not eligible for a refund.
* **Flexible Learning (Part-Time) Courses:** Refund eligibility after classes start depends on the course format and length. For example, classroom-based, blended, or synchronous courses longer than four weeks allow an 85% tuition refund if you withdraw prior to the second class. Asynchronous distance education courses longer than four weeks allow an 85% tuition refund if withdrawn within two weeks of the course start date. Continual-entry courses running longer than two weeks allow a 100% refund if withdrawn within two weeks of registration or the start date. 
* **Apprenticeship Programs:** No refunds are issued for any withdrawal less than nine days before the start of class, and refunds are scaled based on how far in advance notice is received (e.g., up to 41 days prior versus 9 days or less prior).

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refun
sub_queries: BCIT refund policy for withdrawing after classes start

* **Domestic Technology Student Deduction:** If you withdraw from a full-time technology program as a domestic student, a $500 commitment fee is deducted from your refund.
* **Withdrawal Deadline:** For most full-time programs, your latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class.
